intent: Apply T01 to the whole loaded F.Cu board, export and review complete native tiles without a crop
location_owner: PCB data ABI: complete input correspondence, source window, full-source and circle occurrence coverage; no image location
audit: One native slice and separate agent observation at every gate; exact facts/digests carried mechanically; no auto approval or workflow loop
failure: Source, export, integrity and observation failures HALT. A retained render_verify pixel-tolerance rejection after all 19 preceding slices/observations can finish report-only as COMPLETED_WITH_FAILED_FINDINGS. Its native FAIL and NOT_RUN checks remain unchanged; no rendering retry, tolerance change or acceptance promotion.
output: Fresh candidate KiCad/Gerber and correctly labelled side-by-side display; complete sources outside selected feature aliases unchanged
scope: Entire supported native F.Cu source: every filled zero-stroke graphic circle and aliases; other copper fixed. Unsupported native semantics halt. Owner PENDING_USER; independent NOT_RUN; electrical/manufacturing NOT_ESTABLISHED
execution: Start/review/completion polls for fresh authorized work. finalize reads retained outputs only, requires no launcher, and never renders, constructs, exports or submits native audits. Completed-with-findings Markdown must be delivered unchanged.
setup: User starts project-local Start_T01_Native_Launcher.command once per working session. Embedded clients use files only; native bridge launches each fresh job. Missing/stale bridge halts before job allocation. No MCP, network, install or global configuration.
lifecycle: One active job per checkout; overlapping commands/starts halt without replacing it. Completed jobs stay read-only. New inputs create a fresh job after a terminal outcome. Same inputs and implementation cannot automatically retry a failed job. Idle/interrupted workers halt; never resume. Runner stops at terminal outcome.
attachment_ingestion: Optional native app-staged KiCad/Gerber replacement labels; defaults are the loaded source pair. No crop/desktop dependency.
pagination: Complete 100-record source/inspection/comparison pages. Display has a complete physical tile partition; no source/target count caps and no silently omitted pages.
policy: Whole-board controlled English version 1, 16 clauses. The existing T01 numeric, interaction, concentric, source-specific, clearance and port rules are retained; R01/R16 select the complete native F.Cu circle pool without an image.
port_evidence: Exact original source-derived port geometries in deduplicated artifacts and complete 100-site pages; all bytes rederived and verified in plan/reconstruction. Existing 200 MB attempt-output guard unchanged.
terminal_output: Compact report and verified full custody-manifest path/hash/count; all tile and export file hashes remain in operator_ui/terminal.json. Nonterminal facts remain complete.
report_completion: Operational completion is distinct from qualification. 19 PASS, one FAIL, one NOT_RUN may close the report. Native original stays HALTED; completion is additive outside the source job. Process exit 0 means report completed, render_qualification remains FAIL.
